empirical_probe_test.query: Vai 2000 takar moddhe valo headphone ase?
empirical_probe_test.un_finetuned_behavior: Model hallucinated fake 'VoltTech 2000 Pro/Elite' models due to mistranslating '2000 takar moddhe' (under 2000 taka budget) as a product series name. Also failed structured JSON schema.
empirical_probe_test.conclusion: Proves necessity of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on cloud GPU before production deployment.

readiness_verdict.recommendation: Proceed with Phase 4 batch expansion to 10,000 examples upon founder approval, adhering to phase4_expansion_plan.md.
